status: PREREGISTERED AND COMPOSABLE — NOT AUTHORIZED TO FLY. No owner GO exists for this cell and none is claimed. OBS-E1 remains REJECTED.
purpose: The FORM TWIN of SAEA-E21-OBS-E1B-CONTEXT-UNITS-V1. It answers the one alternative explanation the arm cannot answer alone: whether any gain came from the SPEAKER-TURN cut or merely from giving every contact more audio and a seam that hears its neighbourhood twice. Everything is the arm's except where the boundaries are.

population.unit_plan_predecessor: docs/receipts/obs/e21-speaker-turn-units-v2.json, from which this plan inherits ONLY the 44-call roster and each call's decoded duration; its units are equal 27.60-second clock units, built by the same builder with --uniform-seconds 27.60
population.selection: no draw: the whole frozen earnings21-original discovery split, the comparator's own population, already exposed many times over.
population.estimand: the pooled delta, comparator minus cell, of ConEC-mirror PERSON entity WER and of corpus WER, over all 44 calls.
population.strata: unit duration is constant here by construction, so the strata are: realized context seconds per unit, boundary ownership rule (anchor / anchor-short / proportional / no-overlap), position in the call, and the release's own sector and sample rate. The arm's duration and speaker strata do not exist on a clock cut and are not invented.

cells.obs: equal 27.60-second clock units, each delivered with the arm's own context rule (5.0 s per side, 10.0 s floor, 90.0 s ceiling, clamped to the call); no VAD trim, no rolling tail, no preprocessing; 2.0 s digital silence tail on the delivered bytes only
cells.text_ownership: saea-obs-context-ownership-v1 — the stitched hypothesis is each unit's own turn, resolved on the overlap both neighbours received
cells.serving_geometry: -c 36864 -np 6, 6,144 tokens per slot, GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU
cells.audio_path: raw audio through the bf16 mmproj on the GPU; no feature cache, no CPU packet preprocessing, no MP3 re-decode

The context bounds and the ownership stitch are THIN derivations on that policy: no module under rails/probes, no TaskAdapter or controller subclass, no launcher directory.

This is load-bearing: the boundary-marker protocol was REJECTED because it would have changed the instruction and made the contrast against OBS-E1 two-factor.

form_twin.what_it_holds_fixed: contact count (5,144 against 5,122), delivered seconds (203,073.853 against 201,558.352), the context rule, the ownership stitch, the instruction, the arm, the geometry and the harness

pairing.statistic: analysis.paired.resampled_statistic on the pooled ratio sum(numerator)/sum(denominator) over the resampled call ids
pairing.power_limitation: n = 44 clusters is BELOW the program's n >= 400 rule for a paired effectiveness claim. This cell reports an interval and a direction and makes NO paper-facing effectiveness claim.

rule.the_twin_has_no_admission_rule_of_its_ow: This cell is a CONTRAST, not a candidate. Its verdict is the ARM MINUS THE TWIN on both metrics, with the same 44-cluster CI90, reported beside each cell's own delta against the sealed comparator.

decision.non_inferiority_margin_basis: 0.25009 points is the PERSON half-width the study's OWN null replicate measured (SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1, docs/readiness/2026-09-08-e21-own-null-replicate-v1-verdict.md: PERSON delta +0.00000, CI90 [-0.24338, +0.25680], max |bound| 0.25009). It is this carrier's own measured noise floor, not an imported number, and it is the margin OBS-E1's harm was 8.4 half-widths outside of.
decision.corpus_wer_has_no_margin_here: OBS-E1 BOUGHT +1.0487 corpus-WER points. A successor that gives that back is not a repair, so the corpus leg is a strict improvement over the comparator (LB > 0), not a non-inferiority.

stop_and_report_conditions.stitch_fallback_rate: proportional + clamped boundaries > 5.0 % of the 5,078 boundaries. The model-free proof measured 0.02 % under a same-arm overlap and 2.9 % under the most adversarial pairing available (an independent decode of the same audio as context), so this fires only if reality is WORSE than that ceiling.
stop_and_report_conditions.stitched_corpus_word_count: outside +/- 15 % of OBS-E1's sealed 368,011 words. A stitch that ate or duplicated the transcript would show here before any metric is read.
stop_and_report_conditions.consequence: the run is reported, NOT scored as clean, and the verdict names the failing guard. This is the same discipline obs_slice_skip_max already applies to skipped audio.

decision.falsifier_before_any_score: for every call, cutting each delivered slice back to its own clock-unit sub-range, dropping the 2.0-second tail, and concatenating those must reproduce that call's sealed saea-diarization-v1 audio_sha256 — the arm's own falsifier, on this plan's boundaries.
decision.claim_surface: Discovery data. No superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim, and no paper-facing effectiveness claim at all. No knob tuned on the evaluation ten: the context rule's three numbers were fixed model-free before any score existed, and the margin ladder in the stitch proof was run for the STITCH's correctness, never for a metric.
